notes: Before grading, the start page now warns when a card's dark artwork runs to the edge on the black lid (or a light edge blends into the white lid): it says which part of the rim can't be measured and to scan it on the other lid too, then press Same card to combine. A clean card on black stays silent. When no frame line can be found (full arts and alt arts: the picture runs to the edge) the note explains why, that the axis isn't counted against the grade, and how to set the lines in the Centering tab. Phone: the dark-surface advice no longer says to use something dark when the card is already on black.
